name: an opted act runs each segment under its scope's capture command and journals the first preimages
an unset slot takes the recipe's explicit default, and without one the act throws before anything changes
an opted act throws for a product command without scoped effects
an opted act throws for a generic target outside its segment scope
an opted act throws for a restore command of another scope kind
an opted act throws for born, which no restore writes
an opted act throws for the life of a record no write brings back
an opted act throws for a recipe for a segment the act does not have
an opted act throws for a created record that exists before its act
a segment that writes nothing leaves no source entry, and an act that writes nothing journals nothing
each ACK retains its accepted receipt in the journal before its entry settles and is collected
a death before the ACK records nothing; the resent entry's replayed result is retained, and a death before its settling keeps it
a refused source keeps its refusal and owns nothing
an epoch change drops each source's other-epoch proof: the requeued source replays into the new epoch, the collected one has none
a changed-epoch answer with no older retained acknowledgement keeps the proof it records before the change
a create in a held removal's window retires the opted removal, its capture command being the deltas' own
releasing an act removes its journal record, values with it
an Add carries the anonymous journal into the bound replica
a Discard removes the product's whole source entries and their preimages
